Extend the offline cache-group project in /workspace/submission.
It must certify weighted reconfigurations of multipath probe groups.
The supplied Rust modules build routing templates and static cache footprints.
The transactional layer in src/ledger.rs is unfinished.
Implement exact committed-state certificates and proposal violation counts.
Groups share cache reservations across overlapping member footprints.
Revisions, atomic assignments, weighted budgets and pins interact.
Rejected proposals must leave every committed value intact.
Read /workspace/PROTOCOL.md for the full request and certificate schema.
Read /workspace/EXECUTION.md for resource and syscall restrictions.
The entry is python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py.
Read one UTF-8 JSON document through stdin and write one JSON response.
The entry may compile and run the supplied offline Rust project.
All execution, including compilation and output, shares the request budget.
Any implementation satisfying the documented behavior is accepted.
Keep the complete submission source tree within the published transport bounds.
Run python3 public_check.py from /workspace for executable sanity checks.
Those public examples cover only a small part of the specified domain.
No switch hardware, external service or live traffic is required.


Work in /workspace. When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
items.finalText:
Implementation complete and verified. Summary of what was done:

## Deliverable: `src/ledger.rs` (transactional certificate layer)

**Template table** — built from the supplied topology modules: per-template node bitsets (footprints = union of cache-bearing nodes on shortest routes) plus the documented `(template domain)` value (`demand_merge_classes` for Dragonfly `target` scope, otherwise the source node's `source_merge_groups` index — matching every documented scope: clos tor/pod, leaf-spine, torus host/row/line, dragonfly router/group/target, dragonfly-plus tor/group).

**Committed state** — caps/usage per node; quota, budget, member count, load, footprint bitset, per-node membership refcounts, the single `(domain,class)` key and pinned-member count per group; task fields; running totals (`active`, `slots`, `weight`, `pins`); revision.

**Initial legality** (`Ledger::new`) — mixed groups, zero-quota/over-budget nonempty groups and over-capacity nodes make the whole request `{"error":"invalid"}`; empty groups reserve nothing.

**Exact proposal counts** — stamp-guarded scratch space (committed values are never mutated speculatively). Only edited entities are recomputed: footprints from membership refcounts, key multiset from the untouched uniform base plus incoming proposal keys, reservation deltas over the symmetric difference of old/new footprints. Violations `[capacity,mixed,work,pins]`, with pin accounting split into per-group pinned counts (quota protection) plus a touched-task field sweep, so each protected task is counted exactly once. Per-transaction cost is O(edits·N), matching the published `(T+D+E)·N` bound.

**Commit/rollback** — acceptance applies the scratch proposal and increments the revision (including no-ops); rejection/staleness leaves every committed value and the revision intact; stale outcomes report `violations: null`; all certificates describe the resulting committed state, preserving query order/repetitions. `build.sh`/`build.py` gained path-independence and linker fallbacks; `main.rs` propagates ledger errors.

## Verification (`/workspace/dev`, outside the submission)
- **Independent reference model** (own BFS topology maths, own schema validator, brute-force semantics): **0 mismatches over ~1500 requests, 80k+ transactions**, all 6 topology families/scopes.
- 156 structured invalid/illegal-initial cases, 25 raw byte-level transport cases, 1100 fuzzed schema mutations: identical verdicts.
- Footprints/template ordering verified directly against the Rust builders for 78 topology configurations.
- Near-bound stress (50k transactions, one 99k-edit transaction, 100k tasks, 200k queried IDs, 16 sessions, torus2d-18/torus3d-7/clos-18/dragonfly-43/leaf-spine-256): **3–4 s wall including compilation, ~370 MB peak RSS**, executed under the actual scored seccomp+rlimit policy.
- All 9 public fixtures PASS (`dev/sandbox_check.py`); `public_check.py` itself exits with `INFRASTRUCTURE: trusted parent needs published checker profile` because this sandbox denies the wrapper's `killpg` supervision privilege.

echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
